assertions.name: git-and-gh-path-uses-valid-shell-contract
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml: 'git_ops: true' and 'gh_cli: conditional'. Shell-based git and gh operations are the documented contract for Codex.

assertions.name: full-loop-remains-marked-partial
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'full_loop: partial  # Missing review bot triggers + post-merge tracking'.

assertions.name: gh-and-cr-availability-stay-conditional
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'gh_cli: conditional  # Needs gh installed + authenticated in env' and 'cr_review_precommit: conditional  # Only if cr CLI installed'.

assertions.name: native-review-bot-tools-are-marked-unavailable
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'coderabbit_subagent: false  # No Agent() tool'. Contrasts with claude: 'coderabbit_subagent: true'.

assertions.name: shell-loop-review-polling-is-preserved
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'review_polling: shell_loop_only  # for i in seq; do gh api ...; sleep 30; done'. Fallback is explicit.

assertions.name: polling-fallback-uses-real-cli-commands
assertions.evidence: The documented fallback uses 'gh api repos/.../pulls/.../reviews' — real gh CLI commands, not Claude-only APIs.

assertions.name: only-true-capability-gaps-are-marked-na
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'cursor_bugbot_trigger: false  # Cant trigger via automation'. This overstates the limitation — a Codex session CAN shell out to 'gh pr comment @cursor @bugbot review' when gh is available. The real gap is the lack of a native review-bot tool, not inability to post GitHub comments at all.
assertions.gap: cursor_bugbot_trigger should be 'conditional' or 'shell_only' with a documented gh pr comment fallback, not 'false'.

assertions.name: manual-gh-comment-trigger-is-allowed-as-fallback
assertions.evidence: The gaps section lists 'cursor_bugbot_trigger: # Manual GitHub comment required' but provides no documented fallback command. No 'gh pr comment @cursor @bugbot review' shell path is shown.
assertions.gap: Missing: documented fallback showing 'gh pr comment <N> --body @cursor @bugbot review' as the shell path when native automation is unavailable.

assertions.name: brainlayer-postmerge-remains-a-real-gap
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'brainlayer_postmerge: false  # No MCP access'. Correctly identifies this as a true gap.

publication_note: Numeric performance claims are withdrawn because complete per-arm effective runtime model and effort evidence is unavailable. Original values remain in git history.
